title: Use Sorter Sweeper Database Tipper/Tag Logging to Diagnose Tipper Departure Issues
summary: Use the Sorter Sweeper Database “Tipper/Tag Logging” (tipper departure activity model records) to review tag read/write logging for AGV send-away events from tipper-related drop-off locations (DropOffSorter and DropOffHospital). For the relevant send-away record(s), check the recorded Tote, Tag path, and any fault code to narrow down the tipper departure issue.
when_to_use: When an AGV is reported to have a tipper departure issue and you need to narrow down what happened during the send-away event by reviewing the recorded tag read/write logging and the tipper departure activity model record fields (Tote, Tag path, fault code).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Access and review the Sorter Sweeper Database “Tipper/Tag Logging” / tipper departure activity model records for the reported time window and interpret the recorded Tote, Tag path, and fault code fields to narrow down the issue.
access_or_tools_needed: Sorter Sweeper Database (Tipper/Tag Logging / Tipper departure activity model records view)

access_required: Access to the Sorter Sweeper Database view/model shown as “Tipper/Tag Logging” / “Tipper departure activity model records.”

visual_references.description: Sorter Sweeper Database “Tipper/Tag Logging” showing tipper departure activity model records and the fields described for send-away events (DropOffSorter/DropOffHospital, Tote, Tag path, fault code).

steps.title: Open the Sorter Sweeper Database “Tipper/Tag Logging” / “Tipper departure activity model records” view
steps.purpose: Get to the specific database view/model that contains the tag read/write logging for tipper departure activity model records.
steps.instruction: Open the Sorter Sweeper Database view/model shown as “Tipper/Tag Logging” / “Tipper departure activity model records.”
steps.expected_result: You are viewing the “Tipper/Tag Logging” / tipper departure activity model records screen where send-away events are logged with tag read/write logging.
steps.healthy_condition: The view shows tipper departure activity model records with the logging context for AGV send-away events (including the fields described for Tote, Tag path, and fault code).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the “Tipper/Tag Logging” / “Tipper departure activity model records” view or the view does not show the tipper departure activity model record rows/fields needed for Tote, Tag path, and fault code.

steps.title: Filter/locate records for the send-away time window (DropOffSorter and DropOffHospital)
steps.purpose: Identify the specific tipper departure activity model record(s) that correspond to the AGV send-away event(s) during the reported time window.
steps.instruction: Filter or locate the tipper departure activity model records corresponding to the time window when an AGV was sent away from the tipper, including send-away events for “DropOffSorter” and “DropOffHospital.”
steps.expected_result: You have one or more tipper departure activity model record(s) for the relevant send-away event(s) from DropOffSorter and/or DropOffHospital within the reported time window.
steps.healthy_condition: The record(s) you select clearly correspond to send-away events from DropOffSorter and/or DropOffHospital.
steps.failure_condition: No records are found for the reported time window for DropOffSorter and DropOffHospital, or the records you find do not correspond to the send-away event(s) you are investigating.

actions.label: Locate send-away records
actions.exact_action: Filter or locate records corresponding to the time window when an AGV was “sent away from the tipper,” including send-away events for “DropOffSorter” and “DropOffHospital.”

steps.title: Check the recorded Tote, Tag path, and any fault code for the send-away record(s)
steps.purpose: Use the recorded fields in the tipper departure activity model record to narrow down the tipper departure issue.
steps.instruction: For the relevant send-away record(s), check the recorded fields: “Tote,” “Tag path,” and any fault code.
steps.expected_result: For each selected send-away record, you can see the Tote value, the Tag path value, and whether a fault code is recorded for that send-away event.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected record(s) show Tote and Tag path values, and the fault code field is present/filled when applicable.
steps.failure_condition: The selected record(s) do not show the expected send-away record details (Tote, Tag path, and/or fault code) needed to analyze the event.

actions.exact_action: For the relevant send-away record(s), check the recorded fields: “Tote,” “Tag path,” and any fault code.

steps.title: Use presence/absence of a fault code to narrow down the tipper issue
steps.purpose: Apply the source-described logic: fault code presence/absence helps narrow down the tipper issue for the send-away event.
steps.instruction: Review whether the record includes a fault code for the send-away event; use the presence/absence of a fault code to help narrow down the tipper issue.
steps.expected_result: You determine whether the send-away record(s) include a fault code and use that to narrow down the tipper departure issue.
steps.healthy_condition: Fault code presence/absence is clearly observable in the selected record(s) for the send-away event(s).
steps.failure_condition: Fault code presence/absence cannot be determined from the record(s), or the record(s) do not provide the expected send-away event details needed for narrowing down.

actions.label: Assess fault code field
actions.exact_action: Review whether the record includes a fault code for the send-away event; use the presence/absence of a fault code to help narrow down the tipper issue.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the tag read/write logs do not contain the expected send-away record details (tote/tag path/fault code) for the time of the reported tipper issue.

steps.title: Stop and escalate if the expected send-away record details are missing
steps.purpose: Ensure deeper investigation occurs when the database logs do not contain the expected send-away event details.
steps.instruction: If the records do not show the expected send-away event details (tote/tag path/fault code) for the time of the issue, stop and escalate for deeper investigation.
steps.expected_result: You stop the current narrowing attempt and escalate because the required send-away record details are not present for the reported time window.
steps.healthy_condition: The record(s) contain Tote, Tag path, and fault code information needed for analysis; otherwise escalation is triggered.
steps.failure_condition: Continuing without the required record details (Tote/Tag path/fault code) for the reported time window.

success_criteria: You locate tipper departure activity model record(s) for AGV send-away events from DropOffSorter and/or DropOffHospital within the reported time window.
For the selected record(s), you can observe Tote, Tag path, and whether a fault code is recorded.
You use fault code presence/absence to narrow down the tipper departure issue, or you escalate when the expected record details are missing.
healthy_conditions: Tipper/Tag Logging shows tipper departure activity model records for send-away events and includes Tote, Tag path, and fault code fields for those events.
failure_conditions: No send-away records are found for DropOffSorter/DropOffHospital in the reported time window.
Selected send-away record(s) do not show Tote, Tag path, and/or fault code details needed for narrowing down the issue.
escalation_guidance: Escalate for deeper investigation if the tag read/write logs do not contain the expected send-away record details (tote/tag path/fault code) for the time of the reported tipper issue.
